negative.title: THE ONLY LEAD WITH NEGATIVE WAR
negative.subtitle: 744 characters. 21 shows. 155,873 jokes.
negative.claim: Twelve characters score below replacement. Eleven are bit parts. One is a main cast member with 1,960 jokes.
negative.caption:
we scored 155,873 jokes across 21 shows and ranked all 744 characters by WAR.

twelve of them land below replacement level. eleven are bit parts.

the twelfth is rachel green.

#friends #rachelgreen #jenniferaniston #sitcom #tvtok
negative.pinned: WAR is joke volume multiplied by how far your average joke sits above a replacement-level character. Rachel has 1,960 jokes at 6.53 average quality against a 6.555 replacement line, so the volume works against her instead of for her. Phoebe is +622 on 2,036 jokes. We used to clamp scores like this to 0.0; we stopped, because the sign is the whole point. Reply with who you think is actually last.

per_episode.title: MOST VALUABLE PER EPISODE
per_episode.subtitle: WAR per episode, 300+ scored jokes
per_episode.claim: Fleabag made twelve episodes and out-rates Larry David by more than double.
per_episode.caption:
larry david has 4,501 scored jokes. fleabag has 500.

per episode it is not close.

#fleabag #phoebewallerbridge #curbyourenthusiasm #larrydavid #sitcom
per_episode.pinned: Total WAR rewards longevity, which is why Larry sits near the top of the all-time list on 120 episodes. Per episode is the fairer question for a show that made twelve. Fleabag 41.72, Ilana 25.15, Larry 19.22, Selina 12.29. Reply with a show you think run length is hiding.

broad_city.title: BROAD CITY MADE 50 EPISODES
broad_city.subtitle: Total WAR across all 21 scored shows
broad_city.claim: Two of the fifteen most valuable characters we have ever scored come from a show that ran fifty episodes.
broad_city.caption:
broad city ran 50 episodes. abbi and ilana both land in the 15 most valuable characters we have ever scored.

friends ran 236 and gets one in, at 15th.

#broadcity #ilanaglazer #abbijacobson #sitcom #tvtok
broad_city.pinned: Ilana is 5th all-time on total WAR with 2,044 jokes in 50 episodes. Abbi is 11th. The only Friends character in the top 15 is Chandler at 15th, on 2,962 jokes across 232 episodes. Density beats runtime. Reply with the shortest-run show you would put up against this.

goat.title: MOST VALUABLE CHARACTER, ALL TIME
goat.subtitle: 744 characters. 21 shows. 155,873 jokes.
goat.claim: Homer has the lowest average joke quality of anyone in this top five. He wins on 9,286 of them.
goat.caption:
we scored 155,873 jokes across 21 shows and ranked every character by WAR: joke volume times how far above replacement level your average joke sits.

homer simpson is #1. he is also the worst writer in the top five.

#thesimpsons #homersimpson #curbyourenthusiasm #larrydavid #sitcom
goat.pinned: Quality index in the top five: Larry David 7.07, Jerry 6.95, Jack Donaghy 7.24, Ilana 7.17, Homer 6.81. Homer is last of the five per joke and first overall, because 9,286 jokes is more than double anyone else. WAR rewards volume on purpose, the same way it does in baseball. Reply with who you would put at #1 instead.

quality.title: BEST WRITTEN, PER JOKE
quality.subtitle: Quality index, characters with 1,000+ scored jokes
quality.claim: Homer Simpson is first on total value and 22nd of 40 here.
quality.caption:
strip out volume and rank characters purely on how good the average joke is.

30 rock takes the top two. homer simpson, our #1 overall, comes 22nd of 40.

#30rock #jackdonaghy #tracyjordan #alecbaldwin #sitcom
quality.pinned: Quality index is the shrunk average of craft and impact, so a guest star with ten lucky jokes cannot beat a lead with two thousand. Pool is the 40 characters with 1,000+ scored jokes. Jack Donaghy 7.24, Tracy Jordan 7.22, Ilana 7.17, Abbi 7.08, Larry David 7.07. Homer is 6.81, between Leslie Knope and Elaine Benes. Reply with the character you think volume is flattering most.
